intro: Brother Nimetz seeks insight into the corruption of Colonel Kurzen by examining dark troll enchantments. Following Kurzen's Mystery, he asks you to venture south into Skullsplitter territory and secure fetishes from their spellcasters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While I study those legends you acquired, gather for me implements of evil troll magic. Enter the territory of the Skullsplitter trolls, a second tribe to the distant south, and acquire Skullsplitter Fetishes from their Witchdoctors and Mystics.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have those fetishes, friend? They might hold the secret to Kurzen's degradation...I must know!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you. I will study these fetishes and see if they hold the secret of Kurzen's fall into evil.
